E091 Informationssicherheit (security, basics of data protection) plus E090 Informationsethik (ethics, personal data); detailed DSGVO/BDSG law application would have to be added

E097 Integrierte Energiesysteme (energy carriers, power-to-X, sizing, evaluation) plus E098 Intelligente Stromnetze (renewables, storage, demand-side management)

E184 Unternehmenskommunikation covers PR, internal/external communication and communication concepts; communication controlling to add
